# Translate and dub a video ad for 8+ markets — ElevenLabs v4 and lip sync

**One video ad becomes per-market versions: transcreated script, same voice, lip sync on talking faces, captions in that language.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_9d760b17d950.webp" alt="An English glove ad and its Spanish market version play side by side on laptops with a pen pointing at prices, each with its own burned-in captions." width="480"></p>

Turns one video ad into versions for 8+ TikTok Shop and Meta markets on varg: transcreates the script per market (hook, slang, claims, units, local price and currency from an offer card, each line fitted to its time slot), voices it with ElevenLabs v4 in the same voice, lip-syncs only shots where a face talks for more than 1.5 s (Sync v3), rebuilds captions and on-screen text in the target language instead of inpainting them, re-cuts every shot on the new language's words, and ends with a native-review checklist. Use when a seller asks to translate an ad, dub a video ad, localize for TikTok Shop markets (UK, DE, FR, IT, ES, ID, TH, VN, MY, PH, JP, MX, BR, SA), make a Spanish or German version of a winner, or sell cross-border. Not for subtitles on a long video (use a captions skill) or dubbing films and podcasts (see video-skills).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-ad-localize                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-ad-localize --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 73 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Dubbed, re-captioned MP4 per market |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Uses | varg API, ElevenLabs v4, Sync v3, Whisper, FFmpeg, Node.js |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

- "Localize ./gloves-ad.mp4 for TikTok Shop Mexico and Spain, prices in MXN and EUR"
